page.notes: The plate has no page number, running head, catchword or signature. Figure letters are small and partly overlapping the drawings; the letter lists for Fig:1, Fig:7, Fig:8 and Fig:10 are approximate and may be incomplete or wrongly sorted, so they carry no [?] markers. Faint text in the centre and behind Fig:6 is show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The imprint reads "Joh: Conrad Keller Aurifaber fec: et excudit", with the word "Aurifaber" partly obscured by the drawing of Fig:4 at its right edge. The "Fig:10" label and its letters sit close to Fig:8 and may belong to either.
